title: Laser Triangulator
subtitle: Compact optical surface measurement system
summary: A custom camera and dual-laser system for measuring printed surfaces and extrusion behaviour.

content.body: This project explores compact laser triangulation as a practical measurement tool for 3D-printing experiments. A monochrome OV9281 sensor observes two controlled laser lines while an ESP32-S3 manages capture, timing and communication.

content.title: Power sequencing
content.body: The sensor rails and I/O levels are being treated as first-class design constraints while the interface is finalised.
The current work centres on PCB layout, sensor interfacing, optical geometry and a processing path that can extract useful profiles without asking the microcontroller to become a workstation.

title: ESP32-S3 HP123 Inkjet Driver
subtitle: Parallel waveform generation for a colour cartridge
summary: An ESP32-S3 pipeline for queuing nozzle data and driving an HP123 colour cartridge through a timing-critical parallel bus.

content.body: The inkjet driver converts queued colour-nozzle data into the precisely timed digital waveforms expected by an HP123 cartridge. The current firmware migration replaces an earlier I²S-parallel approach with the ESP32-S3 LCD I80 peripheral.

content.title: Current state
content.body: Bus allocation and transfer validation are active debugging areas; this page deliberately does not present the driver as complete.

title: ChromaSlicer
subtitle: A full-colour FDM slicing pipeline
summary: An OrcaSlicer fork exploring textured model import, colour-aware slicing and per-layer raster generation.

content.body: ChromaSlicer is a working fork of OrcaSlicer aimed at carrying colour information from textured geometry into the slicing pipeline. The first milestone established UV-aware import and a surface-data representation attached to model volumes.

items.title: Model import
items.body: Texture-backed OBJ geometry reaches the model with UV data intact.

items.title: Raster scaffold
items.body: A per-layer colour-raster pipeline is connected to print processing.

items.title: Toolpath integration
items.body: CMYK conversion, persistence and deposition strategy remain future work.

title: Filament Scale
subtitle: NFC-aware spool tracking with a local interface
summary: A standalone ESP32-S3 spool scale combining load-cell measurement, NFC identity, storage and a responsive web UI.

content.body: The filament scale is designed to work beside a printer without depending on another controller. It combines an HX711 load-cell front end, NFC, a 240 × 240 display, SD-backed transaction logging and an ESP32-S3 web interface.
The interface is being shaped around reliable zeroing and calibration, clear recovery from sensor failures, readable long names and a binding flow that does not assume the NFC tag is already known.

content.title: Integration status
content.body: Spoolman connectivity, local logging and network-mode behaviour are being developed iteratively.

title: Gigaplex Mini Console
subtitle: A keychain game system on a 15 × 11 LED matrix
summary: A CR2032-powered miniature console with a charlieplexed display, five buttons, an IMU and a buzzer.

content.body: Gigaplex is a compact game system built around severe display, memory and power constraints. Its 15 × 11 charlieplexed LED matrix is paired with five controls, a six-axis IMU, an ambient-light sensor and a buzzer.
The firmware work includes recognisable low-resolution menus, multi-button input, deterministic sand simulation and compact game logic. StarByte is the associated product-brand direction.

title: LumenPnP Upgrades
subtitle: Vision, tooling and feeder improvements
summary: A collection of practical upgrades for component placement, including vision tuning, feeder selection and nozzle tooling.

content.body: This work improves a LumenPnP-based placement machine as a real manufacturing tool. It spans bottom-camera focus and lighting, package-specific vision pipelines, feeder mechanics, nozzle mapping and calibration.

content.title: Engineering by feedback loop
content.body: Most changes are validated against actual pickup, alignment and placement behaviour rather than treated as isolated software settings.

title: Voron 2.4 CAN Upgrades
subtitle: Toolhead communication and a serviceable umbilical
summary: CAN-bus debugging and wiring improvements for a Voron 2.4 toolhead and Cartographer probe.

content.body: The Voron work focuses on making a toolhead CAN installation dependable under continuous motion. It combines firmware and bootloader debugging with a redesign of the physical cable path after repeated conductor failures in the drag chain.
The revised umbilical approach treats conductor construction, bend radius, strain relief and support-wire behaviour as part of the communication system rather than separate mechanical details.

title: Bad Apple MCU Compression
subtitle: 2-bit video inside a tiny microcontroller budget
summary: A deterministic compression format for 15 × 11 grayscale animation targeting the CH32V006.

content.body: The SBV1 format compresses 3,286 frames of 15 × 11, 2-bit grayscale animation into 49,439 bytes. That is 36.47% of the raw packed size, leaving room for firmware and a separately arranged buzzer score.

content.title: Round-trip verified
content.body: The encoded stream was decoded and compared against the source frames before the format was accepted.

title: Firefox Video Capture Extension
subtitle: Reliable capture of browser-delivered video blobs
summary: A Firefox extension fork focused on a dependable recording pipeline, recoverable deletion and storage behaviour.

content.body: This extension work began with an intermittent failure: a video could be detected without producing any recorded output or useful error. The recording pipeline was compared with a reliable upstream implementation and reworked around the proven flow.
Follow-up work addresses deletion that remains stuck in a clearing state, accumulated site storage and the practical limits of long-running captures.

title: OpenPnP Vision Tools
subtitle: Package-aware detection and calibration workflows
summary: Vision-pipeline experiments for fiducials, dark component bodies, transparent tape and bottom-camera alignment.

content.body: These experiments tune OpenPnP pipelines for the difficult cases that generic thresholding does not solve cleanly: black switch bodies, transparent feeder tape, hole-based fiducials and low-mounted bottom cameras.
The emphasis is on predictable intermediate images and parameters that remain understandable at the machine, where a false positive is more expensive than an untidy preview.

title: Custom PCB Development
subtitle: Reusable notes from compact embedded boards
summary: A developing collection of design, sourcing and assembly lessons from custom embedded hardware.

content.body: This draft will collect cross-project PCB notes once the examples and photographs are ready for public presentation.

title: Charlieplexed LED Matrix Games
subtitle: Recognisable interaction at extremely low resolution
summary: A compact firmware architecture for games, menus, IMU input and sound on a 15 × 11 LED display.

content.body: The firmware architecture separates input polling, game state, display scanning and buzzer timing so each can remain small and predictable on the CH32V006.

content.title: Display constraint
content.body: At 15 × 11 pixels, a menu icon has to communicate before it has enough pixels to decorate itself.
Current concepts include Tetris, Snake, an IMU-driven sand simulation, dice and compact settings screens designed around the physical 2 mm LED pitch.
